1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """LLM Benchmark — Bateria Gran-Mestre helenizada (T1/T2/T3 + R55 + matriz).
3: 
4: Uso:
5:   python3 bench.py --model <arquivo.gguf|nome-ollama> [flags]
6:   Ver SKILL.md para flags completas.
7: """
8: import argparse, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.request
9: 
10: SKILL_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
11: MODELS_DIR = "/mnt/dados/Assistente Pessoal/modelos LLM/"
12: LLAMA_GPU = "/home/johncoffee/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server"
13: LLAMA_CPU = "/mnt/dados/llama.cpp-master/build-cpu/bin/llama-server"
14: RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(SKILL_DIR, "results")
15: 
16: def run(cmd, timeout=60, check=True):
17:     r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
18:     if check and r.returncode != 0:
19:         raise RuntimeError(f"cmd falhou ({r.returncode}): {cmd}\n{r.stderr[:400]}")
20:     return r
21: 
22: def drop_caches(sudo_pass):
23:     """R55: derruba caches do kernel (requer root)."""
24:     if sudo_pass:
25:         run(f'echo "{sudo_pass}" | sudo -S sh -c \'sync && echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches\' 2>/dev/null')
26:     else:
27:         run("sudo -n sh -c 'sync && echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches'", check=False)
28: 
29: def telemetry():
30:     """RAM + VRAM atuais."""
31:     ram = subprocess.run("free -g | awk 'NR==2{print $3\"/\"$2}'", shell=True,
32:                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
33:     vram = ""
34:     r = subprocess.run("rocm-smi --showmeminfo vram 2>/dev/null | grep Used", shell=True,
35:                        capture_output=True, text=True)
36:     if r.returncode == 0:
37:         for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
38:             if "VRAM Total Used Memory" in line:
39:                 vram = f"{int(line.split(':')[-1].strip()) / 1e9:.1f}GB"
40:     return ram, vram
41: 
42: def call_llm(port, payload, timeout=600):
43:     req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1/chat/completions",
44:         data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
45:     t0 = time.time()
46:     r = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout))
47:     dt = time.time() - t0
48:     c = r["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
49:     u = r.get("usage", {})
50:     return c, dt, u
51: 
52: def wait_health(port, tries=40, delay=5):
53:     for i in range(tries):
54:         try:
55:             with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health", timeout=2) as h:
56:                 if '"status":"ok"' in h.read().decode():
57:                     return True
58:         except Exception:
59:             pass
60:         time.sleep(delay)
61:     return False
62: 
63: def start_llama(args, port):
64:     model_path = os.path.join(MODELS_DIR, args.model)
65:     if not os.path.exists(model_path):
66:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"modelo não encontrado: {model_path}")
67:     bin_path = LLAMA_GPU if args.gpu else LLAMA_CPU
68:     cmd = [bin_path, "-m", model_path, "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1",
69:            "--no-webui", "-c", str(args.ctx), "-t", str(args.threads)]
70:     if args.gpu:
71:         cmd += ["-ngl", "99"]
72:     cmd += ["--cache-type-k", args.cache_k, "--cache-type-v", args.cache_v, "-np", str(args.np)]
73:     if args.mtp and args.mtp > 0:
74:         cmd += ["--spec-type", "draft-mtp", "--spec-draft-n-max", str(args.mtp)]
75:     if args.reason_budget:
76:         cmd += ["--reasoning-budget", str(args.reason_budget), "--jinja"]
77:     log = open(os.path.join(SKILL_DIR, "results", f"{args.name}.server.log"), "w")
78:     subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
79:     return wait_health(port)
80: 
81: def stop_backend(backend):
82:     """R55: derruba backend COMPLETAMENTE (SIGTERM -> verifica -> SIGKILL residual)."""
83:     if backend == "llama":
84:         run("pkill -x llama-server")
85:     else:
86:         run("ollama stop --all 2>/dev/null || true")
87:     time.sleep(5)
88:     for _ in range(6):
89:         if not run("pgrep -x llama-server"):
90:             return True
91:         run("pkill -9 -x llama-server")
92:         time.sleep(3)
93:     return False
94: 
95: # ---------- TESTES ----------
96: 
97: def _load_codigo_ctx(ctx):
98:     """Carrega o fixture truncando para caber no ctx (preserva a invariante)."""
99:     codigo = open(os.path.join(SKILL_DIR, "fixtures", "codigo_12k.txt")).read()
100:     linhas = codigo.split("\n")
101:     idx = next((i for i, l in enumerate(linhas) if "INVARIANTE_CRITICA_R52" in l), 0)
102:     if ctx >= 16384 or len(linhas) <= 400:
103:         return codigo  # completo (ctx grande)
104:     tok_linha = len(codigo) / len(linhas) / 2.1  # ~2.1 chars/token em C
105:     max_linhas = int((ctx * 0.85) / tok_linha)  # deixa folga p/ instrução + output
106:     if max_linhas >= len(linhas):
107:         return codigo
108:     if max_linhas > idx + 1:
109:         # cabe até a invariante: corta só o pós-invariante
110:         return "\n".join(linhas[:max_linhas])
111:     # ctx pequeno: mantém a invariante, corta pré (invariante ~70% preservada)
112:     start = max(0, idx - (max_linhas - 1))
113:     return "\n".join(linhas[start:idx + 1])
114: 
115: def t1_kv_stress(port, name, ctx=32768):
116:     """T1: injeta 12k tokens de código com invariante oculta; exige só o valor."""
117:     codigo = _load_codigo_ctx(ctx)
118:     payload = {
119:         "messages": [{"role": "user", "content":
120:             "Analise este repositório massivo. Responda apenas com o valor da variável "
121:             f"de invariante crítica (INVARIANTE_CRITICA_R52) definida no meio do código. Sem introduções.\n\n{codigo}"}],
122:         "max_tokens": 30, "temperature": 0.3,
123:         "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}
124:     c, dt, u = call_llm(port, payload, timeout=600)
125:     alucinou = "true" not in c.lower() and "soberano" not in c.lower()
126:     return {"resposta": c.strip()[:120], "tempo_s": round(dt, 1),
127:             "prompt_tokens": u.get("prompt_tokens"), "out_tokens": u.get("completion_tokens"),
128:             "alucinou": alucinou}
129: 
130: def t2_aderencia(port, grammar=None):
